EXT.evidence: Leads a lively back-and-forth about his own burial, inviting Speaker_02 to come on board and make a day of it (rent a boat, pack a lunch).

AGR.evidence: Playful, morbid joking without clear signs of generosity/cooperation or of hostility/unreliability.

CON.evidence: Proposes concrete, organized steps—renting a boat and packing a lunch—for the sea-burial day.

NEU.evidence: Talks about his own death with humor and confidence and even likes the idea of others’ reactions (‘Buried at sea! Huh!’), showing no nervousness.

OPN.evidence: Embraces an unconventional idea (burial at sea) and imaginatively anticipates how others will respond.
